chapter_seo_title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality Ch. 457 – The Lure is Set
chapter_meta_description: Xuan Gu and Han Li lay their traps for the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng, but hidden layers of deception run deep—both men are playing a game only one knows he has already lost.
og_title: The Hunt for the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng Begins
og_description: Xuan Gu sets a foul-smelling lure, but Han Li has already planted his own countermeasures—who will spring the first trap?
twitter_title: RMJI Ch. 457 – The Rabbit Steps In
twitter_description: The Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng arrives in the form of a white rabbit—but is it truly caught, or just probing the formation?

lore_anchors.definition: A legendary spiritual herb that can transform into animal forms and is exceptionally difficult to capture; its main body is hidden separately from its incarnation.
A powerful tracking technique that scans the environment for specific spiritual auras; it is invasive and often used for locating hidden targets.
A strange spirit beast prized for the calming incense from its horn; ironically, its feces is what attracts the Nine-Bend Spirit Ginseng.
A Yang-aligned lightning inherent to Golden Lightning Bamboo, capable of instantly erasing Yin-type ghostly entities; it is a finite resource that must be recharged.
An animate undead mist that drains life and traps souls; Xuan Gu used it to exhaust Han Li's divine lightning earlier.
